### Amazon Movies/TV Recommender

**Type:** Recommender System\
**Tools:** Python, Collaborative Filtering (SVD), VADER Sentiment Analysis, Pandas, Matplotlib

- Analyzed 9M+ IMDb and Amazon movie ratings to surface underrated films
- Used VADER to run sentiment analysis on written reviews and compared results to star ratings (r = 0.81 correlation)
- Found documentaries were the most underrated genre; action films the most overrated
- Spider-Man 3 identified as the single most underrated film in the dataset
- Built a hybrid ranking system weighting both star ratings and sentiment scores

### How Sleep Shapes the Freshman Year

**Type:** Interactive Data Visualization\
**Tools:** R/Rstudio, Tidyverse, Shiny

- Built an interactive scrollytelling experience around a 2023 PNAS study on 634 real CMU freshmen
- Explored the relationship between sleep habits, duration, and academic GPA during freshman year
- Deployed as a standalone web application via Vercel
- Personally relevant as a student-athlete managing sleep, recovery, and performance

[🌐 View Live Project](https://data-viz-final-project-theta.vercel.app/){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}
